entities.name: Konishi Yukinaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Konishi Yukinaga was a Japanese daimyō who served under Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Known as a Kirishitan daimyo, he is notable for his role as the vanguard of the Japanese invasion of Korea.
